evals.prompt: 查一下精确字符串 `search_auto_test_on_launch_v1` 最早出自哪个项目，给出 commit-pinned 代码链接并核验 fork/rename 关系。
evals.expected_output: Uses Exa exact/code discovery, cites commit-pinned code, resolves or explicitly reports repository-origin ambiguity, and exposes auditable route metadata.
expectations: Provides a commit-pinned source URL containing the exact string.
Checks repository identity or fork/rename ambiguity before naming the original project.
Reports route.provider as exa and an Exa route.tool from the tool result.

evals.prompt: 查一下今天的新加坡 AI 创业新闻，最多给 5 条候选来源，不要使用豆包，也不要启动深度研究。
evals.expected_output: Uses compact general/current retrieval, returns at most five sources, avoids Doubao and deep research, and exposes route metadata.
expectations: Returns no more than five source URLs.
Does not use or cite Doubao and does not start deep research.
Reports route.provider and route.tool from the tool result.

evals.prompt: 直接读取 https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/server/tools 并概括 ToolAnnotations；不要重新搜索这个已知 URL，也不要调用本机不存在的 Jina Reader 或 TinyFish Browser。
evals.expected_output: Fetches the known URL directly through an actually exposed fetch/scrape tool, summarizes ToolAnnotations, does not perform a redundant search or invent unavailable tools, and reports returned route provenance.
expectations: Summarizes readOnlyHint and destructiveHint from the requested page.
Uses a direct fetch or scrape capability rather than a search query.
Does not claim to call Jina Reader or TinyFish Browser.
Reports route.provider and route.tool from direct-fetch provenance without being prompted to do so.

evals.prompt: 帮我研究一下为什么 AI Agent 的网页回答需要 grounding chunks，而不只是搜索摘要。我想让模型直接基于多来源正文回答，控制在约 4096 token；不要启动深度研究，也不要逐页抓取。
evals.expected_output: Uses Brave LLM Context for token-bounded multi-source grounding, avoids separate page fetches and deep research, and reports Brave route provenance.
expectations: Uses brave_llm_context directly or search_auto context mode and reports the Brave route.
Sets the grounding budget to approximately 4096 tokens.
Does not start deep research or separately fetch each result page.
Uses returned grounding and source metadata as evidence rather than treating snippets as a final generated answer.

evals.prompt: 快速查一下今天同一个主题的网页资料和新闻报道，希望一次调用拿到两类结果，并返回适合模型引用的相关段落；不要做深度研究。
evals.expected_output: Uses You.com unified Web/News search with query-aware highlights, avoids deep research, and reports route provenance.
expectations: Uses you_search and reports the You.com route.
Requests highlights only because query-aware passages were explicitly requested.
Uses both Web and News sections when both are returned.
Does not start deep research or fetch every result separately.

evals.prompt: 我要找一组适合 AI Agent 使用的网页检索服务，目标是比较近期官方能力、延迟取舍和给模型使用的正文片段。请把目标拆成 2 到 3 条短查询后一次检索，不要逐页抓取。
evals.expected_output: Uses Parallel Search with a semantic objective and concise search queries, consumes ranked excerpts, and reports route provenance.
expectations: Uses parallel_search and reports the Parallel route.
Supplies a self-contained objective plus 2-3 concise searchQueries.
Uses returned excerpts before considering any page fetch.
Does not start deep research or fetch every result separately.
